reviews.author: Betny Townsend
reviews.text: We love GreenGuard’s service. We’ve gotten so many of our neighbors to sign up you’d think we were on the payroll. For a lot of folks in our circle, anything that harms pollinators is a non-starter, and this has been the best thing we’ve tried by far for mosquitos. It’s sooo satisfying to look at the bag of trapped mosquitoes after it’s rained. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jim S
reviews.text: Great service, really hammers the mosquitos.

reviews.author: Michael Gorski
reviews.text: These guys are the real deal! If you have a mosquito machine, they are a must have and it won’t cost you any more money going on getting the CO2 yourself. Excellent service! I cannot tell you how much anxiety they relieve me of lol

reviews.author: Roger Anderson
reviews.text: After about 20 years of putting in the patio we are finally able to use it.  Even though our pest control does a great job,  their sprays and crystals never really did the job.  Our neighbors told us about GreenGuard and we couldn't be happier to sit out and not be chased into the house because of the mosquitoes.  Thanks to GreenGuard we are truly enjoying our patio for the first time.

manual.author: Sarah M.
manual.text: We used to eat dinner inside all summer. Now our patio is the most-used room in the house. No pesticides around our kids — that peace of mind is priceless.

manual.author: David K.
manual.text: The rental program is worth every penny. They handle everything — I didn't even notice when they swapped the tank. My yard is just always protected.

manual.author: Linda R.
manual.text: I garden constantly and was terrified of sprays hurting my bees. GreenGuard USA was the only option I trusted. Bees are thriving, mosquitoes are gone.

manual.author: Marcus T.
manual.text: I was skeptical. I've tried sprays, citronella candles, everything. Within 10 days of the rental trap going in, I stopped getting bitten on my patio entirely. It genuinely works.

manual.author: Jennifer L.
manual.text: The rental program was perfect for us. We didn't want to spend thousands upfront. GreenGuard handles everything, the CO₂ shows up every month, and my kids play outside again all summer.
